subject: Cloud channel SKU coverage & co-sell readiness — ops plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud channel SKU coverage - initial proposal

Team —

Putting a first-pass proposal on the table for how we list and package Redwood across AWS/Azure/GCP. Goal: limit SKU fragmentation while making the co-sell motion straightforward for each cloud partner. Attached: redwood_marketplace_SKU_matrix_v2.xlsx with SKU codes and region priorities. High-level: 

- AWS: Offer two primary marketplace SKUs — "Redwood Hosted (Pay-as-you-go)" and "Redwood Dedicated (Reserved)". Prioritize us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1 for initial rollouts. AWS co-sell prefers a simple hosted SKU plus a reserved SKU that maps to our Dedicated offering.
- Azure: Bundle a "Redwood Managed" SKU that includes the private deployment option + premium support add-on (separate metered add-on). Push EU and UK regions first (w/ commercial marketplace incentives).
- GCP: Start with a single hosted SKU with an explicit note about private deployments being handled off-market as a licensing option; prioritize us-central1 and europe-west1. GCP wants minimal SKUs to speed approval.

Questions for the group:
- Is two SKUs on AWS + one add-on sufficient or should we create a separate "Redwood Enterprise (custom)" listing?
- Region sequencing: any compliance/regulatory constraints we must front-load?
- Ops: what packaging differences are required for Azure VM images vs GCP containers?

Please review the attached matrix and reply with redlines by EOD. I will consolidate and then loop in the cloud partner leads (Priya/Miguel/GCP).

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_SKU_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud channel SKU coverage - initial proposal

Jonas —

Thanks for pulling this together, this is the right direction. A few quick notes: 

- Azure: strongly recommend we add a "support tiers" add-on (Standard / Premium) instead of baking support into the SKU. That gives partners flexibility and keeps the co-sell price simple.
- AWS: co-sell teams care about 1) predictable margins for partners and 2) a clear listing page differentiator. Let's call the reserved SKU "Redwood Dedicated — Reserved" and make the billing cadence monthly for marketplace customers to align with partner incentives.
- GCP: agree on one SKU at launch. Include a short FAQ on the listing about "how to purchase dedicated/private" so sales reps can direct large customers without adding an additional SKU.

I also want a short decision doc for sales — one pager that tells reps which SKU to recommend for common customer profiles (startups vs enterprise). Marissa/ Karthik — can you two draft that?

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett | VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud channel SKU coverage - initial proposal

Hi all —

Couple of operational items to flag before we finalize SKU design: 

- Azure packaging: the marketplace image needs our telemetry agent to be packaged as an extension for Microsoft’s VM offer. That means we should version the extension separately from the core runtime.
- KMS / Key control: For Dedicated / Private SKUs, customers will demand customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS). We need to confirm which clouds support passing KMS info at purchase time vs requiring post-provisioning configuration.
- Region-specific compliance: APAC launches will require data residency docs for a subset of customers in AU/NZ. We should mark those regions as "support on request" in the matrix rather than full availability at launch.

I made a few edit suggestions directly in the SKU_matrix file (minor naming tweaks and a column for "provisioning complexity").

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aws-partners.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@microsoft.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@partner.gcp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cloud channel SKU coverage - initial proposal

Priya / Miguel / GCP team —

Forwarding our internal SKU matrix and a draft co-sell playbook. We're aligning on minimal initial SKUs per cloud and sequencing regions. High-level asks for each partner:

- AWS (Priya): confirm whether AWS Marketplace supports two SKUs as a single-page listing (hosted + reserved) with monthly billing cadence for reserved. Also need your recommended partner incentive play for co-sell.
- Azure (Miguel): does Microsoft prefer the support tiers as add-ons or integrated SKUs for co-sell? Any packaging constraints for the VM extension approach?
- GCP: can you confirm the minimum listing requirements for a hosted-only SKU and the timeline to publish?

Attachments: draft_co-sell_playbook.docx, redwood_marketplace_SKU_matrix_v2.xlsx

Can you reply with the yes/no and any blocking items by EOD PT? We'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aws-partners.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cloud channel SKU coverage - initial proposal

Jonas —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick answers from AWS side: 

- Two SKUs (hosted + reserved) on a single listing is supported; we recommend distinct SKUs as you proposed. Monthly billing cadence for reserved via Marketplace is fine — we do see better partner economics with that approach.
- Co-sell incentive: we can include this into our partner-led co-sell program (need to register the offer under your AWS Partner Central account). I'll send the registration checklist.
- Regions: us-east-1 and eu-west-1 are standard; ap-southeast-1 is fine but will require us to validate data residency language on the listing.

Attached: aws_listing_checklist.pdf — includes required metadata fields, publisher ID, and the listing test plan. Next steps: please send a pricing sheet for both SKUs and your AP contact for marketplace registration.

Priya Rao | Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
priya.rao@aws-partners.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
Attachment: aws_listing_checklist.pdf (pdf)
